tail:
Batch 52 is authored: 26 A-page items and 3 B-page examples, with frontmatter-only pages. I corrected the signed projection to account for cancellation before taking Jordan parts and added the three required measure-theory prerequisites. The [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-52.notes.md) contain the item claims, dependencies, source locators, checks, and decisions.

**Checks:** Statement-first passed for 29 items; proof layout passed for 29 items and 72 steps; strict contracts passed 29/29; citation fidelity found no missing quotes; scoped dependency checks passed; coverage passed with 57 harvested results; source fetch verified 6/6 records. All 54 in-run dependency edges, 25 external supplier hashes, and batch-52 levels reconcile. The full-run level audit still reports 9 errors in other batches; batch 52 has none.

**Escalated:** 4 items remain at full claim strength for owner reconciliation:

- [Partial-projection stationarity](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-partial-homogeneous-projection-limit-is-stationary.md): signed weak convergence controls only the difference of the positive and negative measures, not the separate branchwise dissipation needed for stationarity.
- [Partial-projection escape](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-partial-homogeneous-escape-from-nonoptimal-projection.md): the negative-weight dynamics use \(G_-\), while the cited crossing argument uses \(G_+\); the stated assumptions do not bridge that gap. Noncancelling BL control and the unbounded-boundary estimate also remain unresolved. This is an inference from comparing the dynamics with [Chizat–Bach, Appendix C.4.2](https://arxiv.org/html/1805.09545).
- [Partial projected-limit theorem](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-partial-homogeneous-projected-limit-is-global-minimizer.md): depends on those two gaps and additionally needs a penalty-convergence result; equal signed projections can have penalties 1 and 3.
- [Partial W2 corollary](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/cor-partial-homogeneous-wasserstein-limit-is-global-minimizer.md): inherits the projected-limit theorem’s unresolved obligations.

The AGS §11.2 Theorem 11.2.1 locator now records the full passage and its stronger convexity assumptions as context only ([AGS PDF](https://www2.stat.duke.edu/~sayan/ambrosio.pdf)). Step 1 records are 25 `ready` and 4 `escalated`, written without `--owner`. A scoped hash audit found no stale or missing records. The full-run check is blocked by unidentified item rows in another batch. Latest autopilot status is 85/101 pairs at `1-scaffold`, with owner repair/recertification and a missing prerequisite file blocking the run.
